Select compound_chembl_id AS chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id AS chembl_id, target_name AS pref_name, target_organism AS organism. Source molecule_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy, compound_structures, compound_records, docs, activities, assays, target_dictionary. Join molecule_hierarchy ON parent_molregno from parent molecule_dictionary row where chembl_id is 'CHEMBL2105717' to include parent and all salts. Join child molecule_dictionary rows on molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno. Join compound_records on molregno. Join docs on doc_id. Join activities on record_id. Join assays on assay_id. Join target_dictionary on tid. Filter target chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL3717'. Filter standard_type equals 'IC50'. Filter standard_units equals 'nM'. Sort by compound_chembl_id, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Return all rows.
